```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```


```{r install}
# Packages needed to RUN this document
needed <- c("haven", "readxl", "writexl", "DBI", "RSQLite", "jsonlite", "dplyr")

# Install only the ones that are missing
missing_pkgs <- needed[!(needed %in% rownames(installed.packages()))]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_pkgs, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

# Load all of them
invisible(lapply(needed, library, character.only = TRUE))

# Confirm everything loaded and show the versions
data.frame(package = needed,
           version = sapply(needed, function(p) as.character(packageVersion(p))),
           row.names = NULL)
```

```{r folder}
# All practice files live in a temporary folder: no paths to change
data_dir <- tempdir()
```

# 2. Creating the Practice Files

```{r make-files}
# A small survey dataset WITH labels, to show what haven can preserve
survey <- data.frame(
  id     = 1:8,
  gender = haven::labelled(c(1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2, 1),
                           labels = c(Male = 1, Female = 2),
                           label  = "Gender of respondent"),
  age    = c(21, 24, 22, 30, 27, 25, 23, 29),
  score  = c(65, 78, 82, 59, 91, 70, 85, 64)
)

write_dta(survey,       file.path(data_dir, "survey.dta"))          # Stata
write_sav(ToothGrowth,  file.path(data_dir, "toothgrowth.sav"))     # SPSS
write_xpt(women,        file.path(data_dir, "women.xpt"))           # SAS transport
write.csv(PlantGrowth,  file.path(data_dir, "plantgrowth.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# An Excel workbook with TWO sheets
write_xlsx(list(Arrests = cbind(State = rownames(USArrests), USArrests),
                Cars    = cbind(Model = rownames(mtcars), mtcars)),
           file.path(data_dir, "workbook.xlsx"))

# A JSON file
chick_small <- head(ChickWeight[, c("weight", "Time", "Diet")], 12)
chick_small$Diet <- as.character(chick_small$Diet)
write(toJSON(chick_small, pretty = TRUE), file.path(data_dir, "chicks.json"))
```

# 3. Importing from Statistical Packages (`haven`)

## A. Stata (.dta): survey data with labels

```{r stata}
survey_in <- read_dta(file.path(data_dir, "survey.dta"))
head(survey_in)
dim(survey_in)
```


```{r haven-labels}
attr(survey_in$gender, "label")          # the variable label
print_labels(survey_in$gender)           # the value labels (1 = Male, 2 = Female)

survey_in$gender_f <- as_factor(survey_in$gender)   # labels become a normal R factor
table(survey_in$gender_f)

tapply(survey_in$score, survey_in$gender_f, mean)   # average score by gender
```

## B. SPSS (.sav): vitamin C and tooth growth

```{r spss}
tooth <- read_sav(file.path(data_dir, "toothgrowth.sav"))
head(tooth)
str(tooth)
```

```{r spss-help}
# haven imports straight into a data frame that works with dplyr
tooth |>
  group_by(supp, dose) |>
  summarise(mean_length = mean(len), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
```

## C. SAS transport (.xpt): height and weight of women

```{r sas}
women_in <- read_xpt(file.path(data_dir, "women.xpt"))
head(women_in)
summary(women_in)
```

```{r sas-help}
# Quick relationship check once the data is in R
cor(women_in$height, women_in$weight)
```

## D. CSV (base R)

```{r csv}
plant <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "plantgrowth.csv"))
head(plant)
names(plant)
```

```{r csv-help}
plant |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(mean_weight = mean(weight), sd_weight = sd(weight))
```

# 4. Importing from Excel (`readxl`)

```{r excel}
xl_file <- file.path(data_dir, "workbook.xlsx")

excel_sheets(xl_file)                          # list the sheets in the workbook
arrests <- read_excel(xl_file, sheet = "Arrests")
head(arrests)
```


```{r excel-help}
# Which five states have the highest murder rate?
arrests |>
  arrange(desc(Murder)) |>
  head(5)

# Read ALL sheets at once into a list
all_sheets <- lapply(excel_sheets(xl_file), function(s) read_excel(xl_file, sheet = s))
names(all_sheets) <- excel_sheets(xl_file)
sapply(all_sheets, dim)
```

# 5. Importing from Databases (`DBI` and `RSQLite`)

## A. SQLite (runs immediately, no server needed)

```{r db-connect}
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), file.path(data_dir, "practice.sqlite"))

cars_db <- cbind(model = rownames(mtcars), mtcars)
rownames(cars_db) <- NULL
dbWriteTable(con, "cars",  cars_db, overwrite = TRUE)
dbWriteTable(con, "waits", faithful, overwrite = TRUE)

dbListTables(con)             # tables in the database
dbListFields(con, "cars")     # columns in the 'cars' table
```

```{r db-read}
cars_in <- dbReadTable(con, "cars")      # import a whole table
head(cars_in)
```

```{r db-query}
# Filter rows
dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT model, mpg, cyl, hp
  FROM cars
  WHERE mpg > 25
  ORDER BY mpg DESC
")

# Summarise inside the database
dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT cyl, COUNT(*) AS n_cars, ROUND(AVG(mpg), 1) AS avg_mpg
  FROM cars
  GROUP BY cyl
")

# Safe parameterised query (the ? is filled in by DBI)
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT model, hp FROM cars WHERE cyl = ?", params = list(6))
```

```{r db-close}
dbDisconnect(con)
```

## B. MySQL template (needs your own MySQL server)

Change `eval = FALSE` to `eval = TRUE` once your server is running.

```{r mysql, eval=FALSE}
install.packages("RMariaDB")
library(RMariaDB)

con_mysql <- dbConnect(RMariaDB::MariaDB(),
                       host = "localhost", dbname = "your_database",
                       user = "root", password = "your_password")
dbListTables(con_mysql)
dbGetQuery(con_mysql, "SELECT * FROM your_table LIMIT 5")
dbDisconnect(con_mysql)
```

## C. Microsoft Access template (Windows only)

```{r access, eval=FALSE}
install.packages("odbc")
library(odbc)

con_access <- dbConnect(
  odbc::odbc(),
  .connection_string = paste0(
    "Driver={Microsoft Access Driver (*.mdb, *.accdb)};",
    "Dbq=C:/path/to/your_database.accdb;"))
dbListTables(con_access)
dbDisconnect(con_access)
```

# 6. Importing JSON and Web APIs (`jsonlite`)

## A. A JSON file

```{r json-file}
chicks <- fromJSON(file.path(data_dir, "chicks.json"))
head(chicks)
str(chicks)
```


```{r json-help}
toJSON(head(chicks, 2), pretty = TRUE)    # data frame -> JSON text
```

## B. A live web API (current weather in Kigali)

```{r api}
url <- paste0("https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast",
              "?latitude=-1.94&longitude=30.06&current_weather=true")

weather <- tryCatch(fromJSON(url), error = function(e) NULL)

if (!is.null(weather)) {
  as.data.frame(weather$current_weather)
} else {
  cat("No internet connection, so the API chunk was skipped.")
}
```

# 7. Using Built-in Datasets

```{r builtin}
data("mtcars")
variable.names(mtcars)
```

Average fuel efficiency by number of cylinders using `by()`:

```{r builtin-by}
by(mtcars$mpg, mtcars$cyl, mean)
by(mtcars$mpg, mtcars$cyl, sd)
```

```{r builtin-plot}
boxplot(mpg ~ cyl, data = mtcars,
        main = "Fuel efficiency by cylinders",
        xlab = "Cylinders", ylab = "Miles per gallon", col = "lightblue")
```
